star.name: Franz Wagner
lines: One rebound shy of a triple-double

story: Up 20 in the third. Milwaukee got within 8 late. Orlando's third straight win; the Bucks' ninth straight loss.
aria: Original illustration of Franz Wagner's steal and Euro-step layup with 42 seconds left that put the Magic up 104–94 over the Bucks. Magic win 107–99. Not traced from footage, not to scale.
